`cbcs_audio.mp4` is the encrypted audio fixture from
`github.com/itouakirai/mp4ff` version
`v0.0.0-20250930132656-98812935a1c7`, `mp4/testdata/cbcs_audio.mp4`.
It exercises the real fragmented MP4 decrypt path without a live wrapper.
The upstream MIT license and copyright notice are in `LICENSE.mp4ff`.
